raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Summary Gated NVFP4 experts using FlashInfer TRTLLM currently round each intermediate partition to a multiple of 128 before the quantization method allocates weights. This unnecessarily expands a 192-wide partition to 256. The gated FP4 layout needs 64-aligned intermediate partitions because gate and up are combined. Let the NVFP4 method select alignment before allocating weights and scales: 64 for gated TRTLLM layout, 128 otherwise. Keep the existing generic TRTLLM alignment for other quantization methods and synchronize the runner configuration with the allocated dimensions. No new base-class API is introduced. ## Memory impact Measured on 4x B200 with a 48-layer, 512-expert gated NVFP4 MoE model at TP4 (rank-local intermediate 192), FlashInfer TRTLLM MoE, identical launch configuration and `mem_fraction_static` for both runs; only this PR's source differs. Per GPU (all four ranks identical): | | Before | After | Change | |---|---|---|---| | Target model weights after load | 29.14 GB | 22.86 GB | **-6.28 GB** | | `max_total_num_tokens` | 11,610,688 | 12,311,616 | **+700,928 (+6.0%)** | | Attention KV cache (K+V) | 66.44 GB | 70.44 GB | +4.00 GB | | Mamba cache slots | 2082 | 2203 | +121 (+5.8%) | The weight reduction matches the removed MoE padding (192 -> 256 per rank across 48 layers x 512 experts, 6.33 GiB). Total device usage at startup is unchanged; the freed memory goes to the KV and Mamba caches. ## Validation - B200: real checkpoint-shard loading, weight processing and TRTLLM forward against the existing independent dequantized reference at intermediate widths 160, 192, 256 and 1024. - New regression fails on the unchanged baseline for widths 160 and 192 (256 allocated instead of 192). - Constructor checks preserve 128 alignment for non-gated NVFP4, FP8 and unquantized TRTLLM paths. - All applicable pre-commit hooks pass (formatting, lint, AST, CI registration and secret checks). verified on AIME26, not affected Kernel time doesn't change before, after, --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :hourglass_flowing_sand: [Run #39202025442](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39202025442) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #39202025378](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39202025378) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #39202025496](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39202025496)
